name: Net
description:
A weighted mesh is bundled with its throwing lines ready to unfurl.

Uses the 2014 weapon damage, proficiency and properties; no 2024 mastery is granted. A hit restrains a Large or smaller creature unless it is formless; the net has no effect on Huge or larger creatures. DC 10 Strength frees a creature; 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) destroys it. A net attack limits the action, bonus action or reaction to one attack. These special rules are resolved by the GM.

weight.notes: Adjusted carried weight for one complete item; 80% of the 2014 baseline.
